title: Reforms Of The Public Service
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the clerk or official that sits behind the desk or the writing table."
The bureaucrat is the clerk or official that sits behind the desk or the writing table.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the creation of autonomous agencies with primary responsibility for coordination the reform process."
The changing trend globally is the creation of autonomous agencies with primary responsibility for coordination the reform process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most important actors in the implementation of public policy."
Governmental bureaucracies are the most important actors in the implementation of public policy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the generation of new ideas about a process or phenomenon or the development of new ways of doing things."
Innovation means the generation of new ideas about a process or phenomenon or the development of new ways of doing things.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continental initiative introduced to deal with the crisis of government in Africa which, over the years, has accentuated poverty in virtually every country within the continent."
NEPAD is a continental initiative introduced to deal with the crisis of government in Africa which, over the years, has accentuated poverty in virtually every country within the continent.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most efficient way of implementing the rule of law: the legal rules are recorded, studied, and applied in a carefully considered and reliable way to individual cases."
Bureaucracy is the most efficient way of implementing the rule of law: the legal rules are recorded, studied, and applied in a carefully considered and reliable way to individual cases.
fib: ______ is a multi-dimensional process involving the reorganisation and reorientation of a system, personality, organisation or institution.
Development is a multi-dimensional process involving the reorganisation and reorientation of a system, personality, organisation or institution.
______ is a sustained process that is people-focused on the realisation that while its target is the people, its tool for achieving the desired change is also the people.
Reform is a sustained process that is people-focused on the realisation that while its target is the people, its tool for achieving the desired change is also the people.
______ is a Tutor-Marked Assignment (TMA) which you are expected to complete at the end of each unit and mail to your tutor.
The major assignment required is a Tutor-Marked Assignment (TMA) which you are expected to complete at the end of each unit and mail to your tutor.

______ is the 'rule of law': it exists in a community in which there is a moral attitude of respect for the law as such, or because the law has been arrived at in a way that is regarded as legitimate.

Rational authority is the 'rule of law': it exists in a community in which there is a moral attitude of respect for the law as such, or because the law has been arrived at in a way that is regarded as legitimate...

Reforms of the Public Service is a one-semester course for students offering the Masters Degree programme in Public Service Management.
